"object", "number", "object".

typeof null is "object" because of a bug in the very first version of JavaScript. Fixing it would break old websites, so it stays.

NaN is a special value of the number type. Its name says "not a number", its type says number.

Arrays are objects. To check for an array, use Array.isArray([]) which returns true.

Source: MDN, typeof operator.
